snippet.title: THE LOST DACHSHUND - Coming Soon!
snippet.description:
Family-friendly adventure game! Explore the islands and help rescue Peanut the Lost Dachshund.

Coming soon!
Wishlist on Steam now!  https://store.steampowered.com/app/1975120/The_Lost_Dachshund/

https://weeniewalker.com/the-lost-dachshund/

Get the original soundtrack now!

Created by a group of developers who met on The Point & Click Discord server. Join us today!  https://discord.gg/EFBwvEQjr6
